m.noInterval: No scheduled change under normal use (inspect per manual)
m.disclaimer: Intervals and costs are general recommendations and reference examples only. They vary by model, year and engine - always follow your owner's manual and your mechanic's inspection.
m.severeHelp: Severe: repeated short trips, frequent traffic jams/idling, unpaved or dusty roads, frequent hills, towing or roof cargo, taxi/commercial use. Oil and filter intervals drop to about half, and automatic transmission fluid (no scheduled change under normal use) is replaced every 100,000 km.
m.storageNote: Saved cars and service records stay in this browser only. Share links contain mileage only - no car name or service dates.
m.timelineNote: Whichever comes first: distance or time. Items without a record assume replacement on schedule (estimate).
m.recordHelp: Either field is enough. Leave blank to estimate from your monthly mileage.
m.yearlyNote: Based on {km} km/year: replacements per year x example cost. Labor, parts grade and shop vary widely.
m.costNote: Car tax follows the Local Tax Act (5% off per year from vehicle age 3, max 50%, incl. 30% education tax); insurance and depreciation are class averages. Maintenance uses the same basis as the schedule tab.

severe.title: What are severe conditions?
items: Repeated short trips before the engine warms up
Heavy city traffic, frequent idling and stop-and-go
Dusty areas, unpaved/gravel/snowy roads
Frequent hills, high speeds or hard acceleration/braking
Towing, camping use, roof cargo
Taxi, police or commercial use

sources.title: Basis for intervals
items: Hyundai Motor Group consumables guide: engine oil & filter 15,000 km/12 mo (severe 7,500 km/6 mo), coolant first at 200,000 km/10 yr then 40,000 km/2 yr, brake fluid 50,000 km, spark plugs 160,000 km

Hyundai owner's manual (2025 Tucson): automatic transmission fluid needs no inspection or change under normal use and is replaced every 100,000 km under severe use. DCT and other transmissions differ by model, so check your own manual
Air filter, cabin filter, tires, battery, wipers and brake pads use general industry guidelines - large variation by model
LPG spark plugs use a shorter general guideline of about 40,000 km
EVs have no engine oil, spark plugs, air cleaner or transmission oil; follow the maker's guide for reducer oil

tips.title: Maintenance tips
items: Tap 'Replaced today' after service to update the schedule instantly
Download the .ics to get a reminder 3 days before in your phone calendar
Check tire tread (1.6 mm limit) and 5-year age regardless of mileage
Check the battery whenever winter starts feel weak
During warranty, failures caused by skipping the owner's-manual maintenance schedule can be excluded from warranty repair, so keep your service records

taxSection.title: Korean Auto Tax
items: Private passenger cars: up to 1000cc 80 KRW/cc, up to 1600cc 140 KRW/cc, over 1600cc 200 KRW/cc
Plus 30% local education tax
5% reduction per year from vehicle age 3, up to 50% at age 12+
EVs pay a flat 130,000 KRW/yr (incl. education tax)
Paying the full year in January saves about 4.6% (2026 annual-payment rate 5%, prorated)

savingsSection.title: Cost Saving Tips
items: Light cars save significantly on tax and insurance
Eco-driving (avoid rapid acceleration/braking) saves 10-20% on fuel
Use insurance comparison sites to find the best rates
Self car wash and self-service fuel save costs
Use Hi-Pass discount time slots for toll savings

maintenanceSection.title: Maintenance Tips
items: Engine oil: 15,000 km/12 mo normally, 7,500 km/6 mo under severe conditions (Hyundai Motor Group)
Check tire pressure regularly
Check brake pad wear indicators
Replace the cabin filter yearly
Check coolant antifreeze ratio before winter

depreciationSection.title: Understanding Depreciation
items: Highest depreciation occurs in the first year (about 20-30%)
Depreciation slows down after 3-5 years
Imported cars depreciate faster than domestic ones
Popular models and white/black colors retain higher resale value
Regular maintenance records increase used car value
